comments.chain:*: Hardhat runs inside a pinned node:20 container, never on the host. Hardhat 2 does not support Node 26 (what this machine ships) and hangs silently with no output on it — so pinning the runtime is what makes these reproducible for every teammate, and means nobody needs Node installed at all.

scripts.dev:up: docker compose up -d --build backend mongodb redis chromadb blockchain
scripts.dev:seed: docker compose exec backend python -m scripts.index
scripts.chain:compile: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat compile
scripts.chain:test: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat test
scripts.chain:coverage: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat coverage
scripts.chain:export-abi: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat run scripts/export-abi.js
scripts.chain:check-abi: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat run scripts/export-abi.js -- --check
scripts.chain:deploy:sepolia: docker run --rm --env-file blockchain/.env -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network sepolia
scripts.chain:grant-anchorer: docker run --rm --env-file blockchain/.env -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat run scripts/grant-anchorer.js --network sepolia
scripts.chain:anchor-demo: docker run --rm --env-file blockchain/.env -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat run scripts/anchor-demo.js --network sepolia
scripts.chain:verify: docker run --rm --env-file blockchain/.env -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat verify --network sepolia
scripts.chain:new-wallet: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/blockchain":/app -w /app node:20 npx hardhat run scripts/new-wallet.js
scripts.chain:deploy:localhost: docker exec sih26-hardhat-1 npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js --network localhost
scripts.chain:pytest: docker compose exec blockchain sh -c 'pip install -q -r requirements-dev.txt && PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q'
